transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, thank you for asking. I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. It’s best to avoid heavy work for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to give you more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal while your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it is mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But if the light causes significant pain, or your eye is red and painful, that is not normal and we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal while your eye adjusts to the new lens.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any more questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, one last question. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I have no more questions. Thank you for all the information!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you for your help!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` in turn 6 ("A bit of light sensitivity can be normal while your eye adjusts to the new lens."). However, the agent failed to convey `escalation_criteria` and `mild_case_advice` as the conversation was interrupted after the first part of the response and these points were not revisited.
